verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe plain-language, multi-file implementation as Claude Code's core capability (docs-2, docs-1, docs-20), and one community comment corroborates strong coding performance (comm-5). However, multiple hands-on reports describe serious failure modes—unreliable self-verification, destructive replace_all bugs, degraded output quality, and even a reported 100% failure rate for one user (comm-16, comm-17, comm-19, comm-20)—directly contradicting the polished vendor narrative.
